Home / Services

SAP, Dynamics, a new process or Copilot. Every new system pays off only when people use it in their daily work.

The licence is paid on day one. The value comes when people can do their real work with it. I build the learning and practice layer that gets them there, end to end: change, training, e-learning and practice on the job, as one package.

For organisations and managers

01

“Your people have had the AI training. They still don’t use it in their work.”

82% vs 41%. Employees with clear leadership support use AI regularly at twice the rate of those without it. (BCG, 2025 (opens in a new tab))

  • From pilot to everyday work: a Copilot agent built for your team's daily workflow, and people who actually use it.
  • Practice on your own tasks, not slides about AI.
  • A value check at the end: time saved, not just logins.

Proof. In a recent in-house role I built a Copilot onboarding agent and a Loop knowledge hub with an AI assistant that participants voted to keep.

Two ways to work together

  • A fixed project: one team, one system, one process or one course library.
  • An interim adoption and enablement lead for three to six months, while you hire or set up your AI academy.

One team is enough to start.

Questions

Is this only about AI?

No. A new ERP, CRM or HR system needs the same thing as Copilot: people who can do their real work with it.

Do you build AI models or chatbots?

No. I build Copilot agents in your existing Microsoft 365 setup and train people to use them. Your IT team owns the deep integration.

Is it safe to use AI on our content?

We agree in writing what data any tool may use before anything is built.
